discrepancy_and_treatment_log.issue: Multi-award lots (3,631 lots with >1 awarded supplier)
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.diagnostic: Multiple AWARDED_TO edges originating from the same lot entity.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.chosen_treatment: Preserve all multiple winners with binary relevance y=1; evaluate with multi-winner Recall@k and ranking metric IDCG accounting for multiple positive items.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.justification: Procurement lots routinely award co-contractors or consortium members; discarding ties artificially truncates true observed relevance.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.remaining_limitation: Consortium structures may imply joint delivery rather than independent substitutability.

discrepancy_and_treatment_log.issue: Chronological anomalies (137 tenders with award before publication; 13 tenders in 2024)
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.diagnostic: Timestamp comparison between HAS_AWARDED_DATE and HAS_PUBLICATION_DATE; out-of-horizon 2024 dates.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.chosen_treatment: Quarantine anomalous records from prospective temporal evaluation partitions.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.justification: Prevents negative duration lookahead leakage and out-of-horizon temporal distortion.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.remaining_limitation: May slightly reduce evaluation sample size in exchange for guaranteed temporal leakage control.

discrepancy_and_treatment_log.diagnostic: Static global graph links computed across the entire multi-year corpus.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.chosen_treatment: Strictly exclude global WORKED_WITH edges from pre-decision feature extraction; reconstruct co-bidding/co-working features strictly on past training-only partitions.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.justification: Full-graph co-working statistics leak future contractual partnerships into historical decision moments.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.remaining_limitation: Historical graph density is lower for early queries.

discrepancy_and_treatment_log.issue: SIREN identifier non-standard formats (136 records out of 15,340)
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.diagnostic: Format check against standard French 9-digit SIREN regex.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.chosen_treatment: Preserve raw identifiers; do not pad or strip arbitrarily; record format validity flag as explicit feature and uncertainty indicator.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.justification: Preserves entity provenance and avoids false registry matching.
discrepancy_and_treatment_log.remaining_limitation: Unmatched suppliers cannot receive external Sirene registry enrichment.
